# blind-api-eval

> Evaluate and improve API, library, CLI or DSL usability through fresh subagents performing real consumer tasks, independent rubric grading and repeated improvement trials. Use when validating an interface design or investigating why consumers misuse it; ordinary implementation correctness remains covered by project tests.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/blind-api-eval
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/blind-api-eval
```

then run `apm install`.

### Any agentskills.io-compatible agent

This is an [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) skill — a portable
`SKILL.md` folder that works with Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI,
Cursor, and other [compatible agents](https://agentskills.io/clients).
